countRationale: Nine core automatic targets: 3+3 vocabulary/expressions, 4 passive, 2 adjective-preposition, 4 past aspect, 4 reading and 4 listening per form. Supporting grammar and present-perfect extension remain Practice-only. Five parallel forms provide bounded alternative-source capacity, not five independent reasoning domains or established psychometric equivalence. Numbers are authoring targets/ceilings, not permission to pad.

writing.countBasis: design proposal aligned to the current standard; not a Topic 2 mandated word count
writing.task: Use a supplied style/work fact card to write a short informational description, explain a preference and respond with a reason to one supplied differing view. An imagined preference is allowed. No external research, lyric copying or access to a paid recording is required.

criteria: task and audience, including information about style/work and a reasoned reply

writing.scoreRelationship: separate teacher result; no addition to automatic denominator

guides.topic: Music words, hearing/listening and voice expressions
Simple passive: actor, receiver and time

batchExecution: Author all 192 candidates, sources, eight guides and one writing package as one bounded unit delivery, using internal groups without per-group owner permission.

Complete candidate-level full-bank and within-batch comparison, natural English/Armenian help, answer uniqueness, feedback/misconception and source trace checks. Rework or report omissions; never fill a numeric slot with a duplicate.
Deliver all ten original assessment scripts and final ASCII filenames in one recording pack. Retain the four existing activity audio candidates; do not request the registered replacement again.

Register accepted text/audio sources and attach actual shared task sets before marking affected questions QA-ready. Stage the complete reviewer package through the existing authenticated workflow. Pending recordings may leave those rows explicitly held.

Batch documentation, required CI and source-verified Notion closure. Exact-version ordinary review, final assessment/readiness/retry/writing workload, exposure and learner-release controls remain in force.

protection.assessmentKeysAndScripts: keep full candidates/keys/scripts and per-item comparison in the restricted review delivery; public Git/Notion may carry redacted counts/IDs/source briefs only
protection.existingPublicUnit1ExposureException: does not apply to Unit 2; assess actual repository and delivery visibility before source/form qualification
protection.playbackProposal: retain unlimited Practice/reviewer playback and two shared plays per assessed source; not a newly bound Unit 2 policy
protection.sameSetQuestions: share a source/play allowance and evidence dependence; not independent stimuli

boundaries.unit1Evidence: reuse unchanged owner acceptance and C26 verification; no new re-approval audit

nextDecision: Accept this exact whole-unit authoring scope, supporting/extension treatment, 120 bounded protected-parallel proposals and writing/audio plan. Final questions, sources, scoring thresholds, workload and release remain subject to their existing controls.
